notes: Asking Crisp to undo something no longer does it: “undo the black and white”, “remove the sepia” or “get rid of the slow motion” used to apply that very effect. Now Crisp points you to Undo (↶ beside “Do it”) and “Revert to original”. It also answers “is it 4K?”, tells you a photo’s size instead of starting an upscale, and understands “never mind”, “one more time”, “equalise the loudness” and “no subtitles”.
